headline: A Press Secretary like none other
dek: The head of the UFC is offered the White House podium, with champion fighters as assistants, to defend the administration against the Lunatic Left.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States. I have requested that he bring with him assistants, even though some are not from our Country, of Islam Makhachev, Khabib Nurmagomedov, Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier, Amanda Nunes, and Kayla Harris. We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job! President DONALD J. TRUMP

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 7 November 2026. Time approximate: shown as “4h” ago at about 6:35 PM ET; posted just before the post on donors.

en: I have offered the position of White House Press Secretary to Dana White, who built one of the most successful sports organizations in the world. I admire his energy and his directness.
The Press Secretary’s job is to inform the American people and to answer the press, including its hardest questions. I am confident Dana would bring candor to that podium, and I hope he will accept.
fr: J’ai proposé le poste de porte-parole de la Maison-Blanche à Dana White, qui a bâti l’une des organisations sportives les plus prospères au monde. J’admire son énergie et sa franchise.

Le rôle du porte-parole est d’informer les Américains et de répondre à la presse, y compris à ses questions les plus difficiles. Je suis convaincu que Dana apporterait de la franchise à cette tribune, et j’espère qu’il acceptera.

text: Adieu ! Un porte-parole qui se bat ? Chez nous, on a les combats de reines : des vaches d’Hérens qui se poussent front contre front pour savoir laquelle mènera le troupeau à l’alpage.
Personne ne se blesse et tout le monde rentre content. Si les conférences de presse à Washington pouvaient se passer comme ça, on enverrait volontiers une reine en renfort.
en: Hello! A press secretary who fights? Up here we have cow fights: Hérens cows pushing head to head to decide which one will lead the herd up to the summer pasture.
Nobody gets hurt and everyone goes home happy. If press conferences in Washington could go like that, we’d gladly send over one of our queens to help.
notes: The “combats de reines” of Valais are traditional, bloodless contests between Hérens cows; the winner is crowned queen of the herd.

text: Un porte-parole entouré de champions de combat, dont certains venus de l’étranger ? À Genève, on a l’habitude des délégations étrangères.
Mais d’ordinaire, elles viennent pour négocier la paix, pas pour assurer la sécurité de la salle de presse. On lui suggère plutôt un médiateur. On en a plein, ils sont libres mardi.
en: A press secretary surrounded by fighting champions, some of them from abroad? In Geneva we’re used to foreign delegations.
But usually they come to negotiate peace, not to handle security in the press room. We’d suggest a mediator instead. We have plenty, they’re free on Tuesday.

text: Un patron de MMA comme porte-parole ? Pourquoi pas. Au moins, les journalistes poseront leurs questions poliment.
Chez nous, le porte-parole du gouvernement esquive les questions avec des phrases. Lui les esquivera avec un crochet du gauche. C’est plus franc.
en: The head of a fighting league as press secretary? Why not. At least reporters will ask their questions politely.
Over here, the government spokesman dodges questions with long sentences. He’ll dodge them with a left hook. At least it’s honest.

text: Un porte-parole qui cogne ? Ça, c’est un homme ! Ici, à Marseille, on connaît l’ambiance : ça s’appelle le Vélodrome un soir de Marseille-Paris.
Et lui, il fait venir des champions du monde entier, du Brésil, du Daghestan… À ce rythme, les conférences de presse se feront au stade, avec les fumigènes.
en: A press secretary who throws punches? Now that’s a man! Here in Marseille we know the atmosphere: it’s called the stadium on a Marseille–Paris match night.
And he’s bringing in champions from all over the world, Brazil, Dagestan… At this rate, press conferences will be held in a stadium, with flares.
notes: The Vélodrome is Marseille’s football stadium; matches against Paris Saint-Germain are the most heated of the French season.

text: Salut les gaillards ! Un porte-parole qui fait de la lutte ? Chez nous, on a la lutte suisse, dans la sciure.
Et à la fin, le vainqueur aide le perdant à se relever et lui enlève la sciure du dos. Si les conférences de presse finissaient comme ça, on signerait tout de suite.
en: Hey folks! A press secretary who wrestles? We have Swiss wrestling, in sawdust.
And at the end, the winner helps the loser up and brushes the sawdust off his back. If press conferences ended like that, we’d sign up straight away.
notes: In Schwingen, Swiss wrestling, the winner traditionally brushes the sawdust off the loser’s back after the bout.

text: Un porte-parole avec des gardes du corps champions de combat… À Lyon, on a Guignol : depuis deux siècles, c’est lui qui tape sur le gendarme avec son bâton, et tout le monde rit.
Mais Guignol, c’est une marionnette. C’est toute la différence.
en: A press secretary with fighting champions as bodyguards… In Lyon we have Guignol: for two centuries he has been beating the policeman with his stick, and everyone laughs.
But Guignol is a puppet. That’s the whole difference.
notes: Guignol, the glove puppet created in Lyon in the early 1800s, is famous for whacking the gendarme with his stick.
